# Oakbase

> Oakbase provides managed AI operations for professional services firms. Oakbase designs, deploys and runs defined operational work around professional judgement, initially for law and wealth management firms.

Professionals retain judgement, advice, strategy and client relationships. Oakbase runs controlled operational execution across approved business systems, with human approval where required and measurement of business outcomes.

## Core pages

- [Oakbase](https://oakbase.ai/): Managed AI operations for professional services.
- [Law firms](https://oakbase.ai/law-firms/): Operations around matters, billing and client delivery.
- [Wealth management](https://oakbase.ai/wealth-management/): Operations around onboarding, reviews and client data.
- [Time Capture](https://oakbase.ai/operations/time-capture/): A concrete operation that prepares billable-time proposals for professional review.
